name: PF-04958242
summary: Pesampator is a positive allosteric modulator (PAM) of the AMPA receptor (AMPAR), an ionotropic glutamate receptor, which was under development by Pfizer for the treatment of cognitive symptoms in schizophrenia. In March 2018, the development of the drug was transferred over from Pfizer to Biogen.

pharmacology.text: Pesampator (INN; developmental code names BIIB-104 and PF-04958242) is a positive allosteric modulator (PAM) of the AMPA receptor (AMPAR), an ionotropic glutamate receptor, which was under development by Pfizer for the treatment of cognitive symptoms in schizophrenia.

uses.text: Pesampator (INN; developmental code names BIIB-104 and PF-04958242) is a positive allosteric modulator (PAM) of the AMPA receptor (AMPAR), an ionotropic glutamate receptor, which was under development by Pfizer for the treatment of cognitive symptoms in schizophrenia. In July 2022, Biogen discontinued the development of pesampator for cognitive symptoms in schizophrenia due to ineffectiveness.

fact.en: It does not switch the AMPA receptor on by itself. It only makes the receptor respond more strongly to the glutamate the brain releases, which is what positive allosteric modulator means.
fact.zh: 它本身不會開啟 AMPA 受體，只是讓受體對大腦釋放的穀胺酸反應更強，這正是「正向異位調節劑」的意思。
fact.zhHans: 它本身不会打开 AMPA 受体，只是让受体对大脑释放的谷胺酸反应更强，这正是「正向异位调节剂」的意思。
